# CoreArchCoverage Contributing Guide
Thanks for your interest in CoreArchCoverage. Following is a guideline to submit your contributions to the project.

Contributions require an issue to be filed. Please select the appropriate fields when [opening an issue](https://github.com/tenstorrent/corearchcoverage/issues/new).

Please be sure to follow the [Code Of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Bug Reports
Bug reports can be filed using an issue on the issue board.

## Feature Requests
Feature Requests can be made on the issue board.

## Support and Discussion
If you need support in using CoreArchCoverage, please look in the Discussions for any previous topics. If there aren't any, please create a new Support topic to get some help in creating and debugging the issue.

## Development - Getting Started
To contribute to the CoreArchCoverage repository, it's recommended to setup all the dependencies. Please be sure to read the [Contributing Standards](#contribution-standards) to understand how changes can be linted and qualified before committing.

## Contribution Standards

### Pull Requests
- Contributions require an issue to be filed and a Pull Request (PR) to be created
- PRs need to have an accurate description of the changes and should link to the existing issue
- Have commits with descriptive messages
- Include relevant tests for new features
- Be focused on a single logical change
- Have changes rebased on latest main branch

### Testing
Code needs to pass lint and unit tests before it can be merged. PRs should include unit tests for any new features.
